where: #renk Durum renkleri: "Durum zemini yoktur (subtle neutral.1)"; #tokenlar att.*.bg and status.*.subtle; #bicim Çizgiler damga: "(attendance.border), içi zeminsiz"
problem: This is the first real confusion. The status chip background has three different answers. The tokens set att.<durum>.bg and status.success/warning/info.subtle to neutral.1 (#FEFEFF), and #kontrast measures att.*.fg on att.*.bg. The prose says the chip has no background. The live .stamp uses background: transparent, and no CSS rule anywhere reads --att-*-bg. A developer who follows the token file will paint a #FEFEFF box behind every chip on hover (neutral.4) and selected (neutral.5) panel rows. #bicim also names a group that does not exist: the path is att.<durum>.border, not attendance.border.
fix: Choose transparent. Delete the six att.*.bg tokens and set status.success/warning/info.subtle to transparent (or delete them). In #kontrast, replace the six att.*.fg/att.*.bg rows with fg on bg.surface, bg.hover and bg.selected. Rewrite the #renk sentence as "Damga zeminsizdir (saydam); tek istisna yoğun tabloda Yok ve Ret: status.danger.subtle". Rename attendance.border to att.<durum>.border.

where: #tokenlar space.phone.satirDikey = 12; #bilesenler Anatomi Liste satırı: "Yatay 16, dikey 8"; #bicim: "tekSatir 56 · satirDikey 12"; #tokenlar: "Bileşen ölçüleri (yükseklik, iç boşluk) token değil"
problem: The vertical padding of a list row is 12 in the token file and the spacing diagram, but 8 in the anatomy table and in the .lrow demo. The Kayıtlar screen rows use yet another set: 12 top and bottom, 8 on the right (.rec-row padding 12px 8px 12px 16px). The choice changes the result: a two-line row is 64 dp with 8 and 68 dp with 12. The root cause is that component sizes live in two places, while the reading key says they are not tokens: space.phone.dugme/tekSatir/ikiSatir/altSekme and space.panel.dugme/kucukDugme/satir* are component heights.
fix: Keep one source. Either remove the component sizes from space.phone and space.panel, so the anatomy table is the only source, or keep them and have the anatomy cite the token names. Set list-row vertical padding to a single value (8, with min-height 56/64) and give .rec-row 16 left and right.

where: #tipografi: "700 yalnız Kalın Metin ayarında (Erişilebilirlik)"; #erisilebilirlik: "ağırlıklar Tipografi eşlemesiyle kalınlaşır, 700 kesiti gömülüdür"
problem: The two sections point at each other, and neither contains the Bold Text weight mapping. Sans ships 400, 500 and 600 plus a single 700 that has to cover three base weights. The font-file paragraph in #kutuphaneler implies Mono 400→600 and 500→700 but says nothing about Sans. The Bold Text branch of the theme hook cannot be written.
fix: Add the mapping as a small table in #tipografi (for example Sans 400→600, 500→700, 600→700; Mono 400→600, 500→700). Store it in the token file as an $extensions boldText value on each type style, and have #erisilebilirlik link to it.

where: #hareket Süreler: "süreler Azaltılmış sütunundaki değere iner (iOS ve panel)" against the Azaltılmış cells in #etkilesim
problem: The token-level reduced-motion durations contradict six pattern rows: focus (dur.mikro stays 100 ms vs "Halka anında görünür"), table sort and filter (dur.hover 120 ms vs "Değişim anında"), tab indicator (dur.uzun→dur.kisa 150 ms vs "dur.mikro 100 ms"), accordion (150 ms vs "içerik dur.mikro 100 ms"), toggle rail (dur.hizli 110 ms vs "ray rengi dur.mikro") and page change (dur.kisa 150 ms vs "Panel: geçiş yok"). The token file can express only the token-level remap (reducedMotion on orta, uzun, genis and imza), so a tokens.css or tokens.ts generated from it gets all six wrong. The page itself mixes the two rules: focus uses animation: none, but .sw keeps dur.hizli on the rail under reduce.
fix: Make the Etkileşim tablosu's Azaltılmış cell the only rule. Delete the Azaltılmış column in #hareket Süreler and the reducedMotion extensions, or add per-pattern reduced tokens (for example motion.focus.reduced = dur.anlik, motion.tab.reduced = dur.mikro) so the generator can produce what the table says. Under reduce, give the .sw rail dur.mikro.

where: #bilesenler Anatomi Bildirim: "Başlık baslik-kompakt-01 (14/18, 600); metin govde-01 (14/20, 400)"
problem: The row gives only panel type names, and the phone scale has no 14/18 600 style. The phone vertical padding and height are missing ("Telefon: solda 16, sağda 0"). The phone demo (.ptoast) is a single line in govde-kucuk with min-height 56, padding 4 0 4 16 and no title. Stack order and the 8 px gap between toasts appear only in the demo. The document does not say whether the 5 s timer pauses on hover or focus. The swipe-to-dismiss named in #kutuphaneler Jestler has no specification.
fix: Split the row into Telefon and Panel. Telefon: govde-kucuk 14/20, one line, min 56, left 16, vertical 4, Kapat 48 x 48. Add "yeni bildirim altta, aralık 8, imleç ya da odak üstündeyken süre durur". Either specify the swipe (direction, threshold, spring) or remove it from Jestler.

where: #hareket Kurallar: "Ok tuşuyla gezinme ve klavye kısayolları animasyonsuzdur."
problem: The live tabs (#bilesenler Sekmeler and the panel filter tabs) run the 240 ms indicator move and the content fade on ArrowLeft and ArrowRight. The page script also binds the table cross-fade to the arrow keys. dur.anlik lists "Klavye eylemleri". The developer cannot tell whether a keyboard tab change animates.
fix: Choose one rule. If keyboard changes are instant, place the indicator without a transition on keydown and remove the arrow-key cross-fade listener. If they animate like clicks, delete the rule and remove "Klavye eylemleri" from dur.anlik.

where: #etkilesim list, toast, dialog, success and banner rows, Telefon column: "giriş ve çıkış opaklığı CSS geçişi"
problem: Reanimated 4 CSS transitions run only when the style of an already mounted view changes; they do not play on mount or unmount. List-item entry and exit, toast entry and exit, and the first frame of the success screen cannot be built the way the rows describe.
fix: For mount and unmount, specify entering and exiting layout animations (for example FadeIn.duration(150).easing(Easing.bezier(0, 0, 0.38, 0.9)) and FadeOut.duration(110)) or Reanimated CSS keyframe animations. Keep "CSS geçişi" only for state changes on mounted views.

where: Cover: "Bu sayfadaki her değer Tokenlar bölümündeki tek dosyadan gelir"; Anatomi: "Ölçüler 4'ün katıdır"
problem: 31 product rules in the screen demos use spacing that is off the scale (6, 10, 14, 18, 20, 22, 28, 34): the receipt timeline .rs (gap 10, padding-bottom 18, 22 px node column, node top 6) with .rcpt margin-top 28, the record tag .tagx (height 20, padding 0 6), .st-note (padding 10 12), the Yok and Ret rose chip (padding 3 8 3 6 with margin-left -6), .qr-info (10 16) and .pnl-head (24 0 20). The receipt timeline and the record tag have no anatomy row, so a developer will copy these values. The record tag is a gray bg.sunken chip, while #durumlar calls it "renksiz ve çerçevesiz".
fix: Add anatomy rows for Makbuz zaman çizgisi, Kayıt etiketi and the rose table chip with on-scale values (for example node 12, line 2, column 24, step gap 16; tag 20 high, padding 0 8, etiket-01 on bg.sunken), and align the demos to them.

where: Anatomi Tablo satırı: "Etkileşimli 48, varsayılan 40, sık 32; başlık 40"; #bicim: "tıklama alanı 40 x 40 px"
problem: The document never says which density the attendance table uses (the demo uses 48), and a 40 x 40 checkbox target does not fit a 32 px sık row. For İncelemede and Beklemede rows the Son durum cell is an empty td with no hidden text, against #erisilebilirlik "boş hücrede görünmez 'kayıt yok' yazısı vardır". The document also does not say what Son durum shows while a decision is pending.
fix: Write "yoklama tablosu etkileşimli (48)" and make the checkbox target 32 x 32 in sık rows. Define the pending Son durum (hidden text or the plan's wording) and fix the demo rows.

where: #etkilesim drawer (yan panel) and popover (ipucu); #tokenlar radius.popover, radius.tooltip
problem: Motion and radius are defined for the side panel and the tooltip, but their width, padding, colors, type and shadow level are not, and neither has a live demo.
fix: Add anatomy rows (for example yan panel 480 wide, padding 24, shadow.3 with scrim; ipucu on neutral.12 with neutral.1 etiket-01 text, padding 4 8, max width 240), or remove both patterns until the panel conversation.

where: #kontrast Ölçülen çiftler: "76 çift · hepsi eşikte ya da üstünde"
problem: 26 of the 76 rows repeat a hex pair that is already measured under another name. For example #143065 on #F2F4F8 appears 4 times, #596074 on #FEFEFF 4 times and #FEFEFF on #1A2030 3 times.
fix: Use one row per hex pair, list all role names in the first cell and apply the stricter threshold. That gives 50 rows and loses no decision.

where: #renk Anlam rolleri: the oklch(...) line on each of the 37 role cards
problem: Each card repeats the OKLCH of the scale step it aliases, which is already in the ramp tables and the token file.
fix: Show only role → step → hex; the OKLCH stays in the ramp table.

where: #hareket Yaylar spring.imza: "%0,12 aşma"
problem: The analytic overshoot for ζ = 0.900 is exp(-ζπ/√(1-ζ²)) = 0.15 percent, and a fine-step simulation gives 0.147. The figure 0.12 is the peak of the 5 percent-sampled linear() curve.
fix: Write %0,15.

where: #etkilesim tab: "Eğri ease.standart"; table: "dur.hover 120 ms" with ease.standart
problem: The tab content fade in the demo uses ease.giris (.tabpanel.in). The table cross-fade runs twice at once (a ghost layer fading with ease.standart plus a tbody fade with ease.mikro), so opacity dips mid-way.
fix: Use one fade with the documented curve in both demos.

where: #etkilesim toggle: "opacity (işaret)"; Anatomi Anahtar: "Açıkken topuzda onay işareti"
problem: In the demo the checkbox check also scales from 0.6 to 1, which the table does not mention. The switch knob check's color (accent.fill), size (3 x 7, 2 px stroke) and the 20 px phone checkbox's check size are not documented.
fix: Add the scale to the table or remove it from the demo, and give the size, stroke and color of both check marks.

where: #tokenlar type.*.lineHeight and font.sans; #kutuphaneler panel Yazı tipi: "Mono 400.css, 500.css, 600.css, 700.css"
problem: lineHeight is stored as a unitless ratio and font.sans as a fallback list. React Native needs an absolute lineHeight (28 × 1.2857 = 35.9996) and a single family name, and no tokens.ts transform is named. The panel loads Mono 600 and 700 although the panel scale uses only 400 and 500.
fix: Name the tokens.ts transforms (lineHeight × fontSize, rounded; first family only) and drop Mono 600 and 700 from the panel.

where: #katmanlar Yükleniyor: "Üç kare time.dongu · doğrusal"
problem: The size and states of the loading mark (three 4 px squares in a 16 px box, rest opacity 0.25, lit 1) exist only in the demo SVG.
fix: Add them to the Düğme row of the anatomy.

where: #etkilesim tab, Telefon: "Göstergenin konumu ve genişliği withSpring(spring.hizli)"
problem: Animating width breaks the #hareket Kurallar rule that width is never animated; the panel already uses scaleX.
fix: Use translateX plus scaleX on the phone as well.

where: #tipografi Panel ölçeği etiket row; #tokenlar grid.panel.narrowBelow
problem: The etiket row's sample text is the same sentence as its usage note (filler). grid.panel.narrowBelow (672) duplicates breakpoint.orta.
fix: Use a real chip word as the sample, delete narrowBelow and use breakpoint.orta.

where: #ikonlar > Boy ve dolgu table, column '24 · dolu'. The .scroll-x box is 544 px wide for 657 px of content at 1440. Evidence: review2/c/ik1440b-00.png
problem: At the reference desktop width the fifth column (the filled icon of the active tab) is clipped. The only hint that it exists is a faint edge shadow, so readers see 4 of 5 columns.
fix: Make the table full width and move the three notes below it, or drop the 16 px column so the table fits in 544 px.

where: Whole page: 443 text nodes at 10 to 11 px. 176 dt labels (Özellik, Giriş, Değer, Bölüm) are 11 px mono, the role-card hex and oklch lines are 11 px, timeline pins and platform numbers are 10 px. The hero says 'Bu sayfadaki her değer Tokenlar bölümündeki tek dosyadan gelir'. Evidence: review2/c/rk1440-01.png, review2/c/et1440-00.png
problem: Neither type scale has 10 or 11 px; the smallest step is etiket-01 at 12/16. The page breaks its own claim, and 10 to 11 px mono in text.secondary is hard to read at 1440.
fix: Map these to etiket-01 (12/16 sans) or kod-01 (12/16 mono). Allow no text under 12 px.

where: Tables across the document: #renk (rule only), #kontrast (white box), #erisilebilirlik and #platform (grey header band), #kutuphaneler (box plus a sticky first column drawn with an inset 1 px vertical line). The document's own rule in #bicim: 'dikey çizgi yok, zebra yok'. Evidence: review2/c/ku1440-00.png, review2/c/er1440-02.png, shots/1440-kontrast.png
problem: One document uses four table looks, and one of them draws the vertical rule the design bans. Carbon and Geist use a single table style.
fix: Pick one style for every document table: 12/16 600 text.secondary header, 1 px border.subtle row rules, no vertical rules. Remove the sticky-column shadow line.

where: #renk > Anlam rolleri, '37 rol' cards. Evidence: review2/c/rk1440-01.png
problem: Every card repeats the step's hex and OKLCH (74 lines) that the scale tables directly above already give.
fix: Show only 'bg.page → neutral.2' on each card.

where: #renk > Durum renkleri: the 'Dolu zemindeki yazı (onSolid)' column is #FEFEFF in all 4 rows; the Son durum 'Zemin (bg)' column is #FEFEFF in all 6; 'Çerçeve' is 'düz' in 5 of 6. #kontrast: 'Eşik' and 'Sonuç' are fully set by 'Tür' (geçer 71, süs 5 across 76 rows)
problem: Constant or derived columns carry no decision, and the contrast table hides them inside a 558 px nested scroller (628 px at 390).
fix: Drop those columns and write one sentence per table ('zemin her durumda neutral.1', '76 çiftin hepsi eşikte'). Let the contrast table flow without the inner scroller.

where: #bilesenler > Anatomi (14 x 8, 578 words) and Durumların renkleri (31 of 105 cells say 'yok'). Evidence: review2/c/bl1440-01.png, review2/c/m-bl2.png
problem: Walls of wrapped prose with no anatomy drawing. The 'yok' cells and type values repeated from Tipografi, such as '(14/18, 500)', add length without decisions.
fix: Leave 'yok' cells blank or omit them, cite type tokens by name only, and move each component's row under its live demo, as Carbon does on each component page.

where: #tokenlar Grup / Tür / Token / İlk yol table, 23 rows; it becomes 92 stacked lines at 390. Evidence: review2/c/to1440-00.png, review2/c/m-misc.png
problem: No decision is in it: the JSON directly below lists every token.
fix: Replace it with one line: '248 token, 23 grup; dosya aşağıda'.

where: #katmanlar Menü and Diyalog demo cards (review2/c/ka1440-00.png)
problem: About 145 px of empty white under the content makes the cards look unfinished while closed.
fix: Show the menu open by default in the document, or let the cards size to their content.

where: CSS for .btn-wait dots
problem: 48 of the 63 animations running on page load are loading dots hidden at opacity 0 inside idle buttons. The page's own rule is 'Boşta hareket yok', and the work is wasted.
fix: Run the dots animation only under [aria-busy=true].

where: #tipografi > Panel ölçeği, row 'etiket' (review2/c/ti1440-02.png)
problem: The specimen and its caption are the same sentence: 'Durum damgası; telefondaki etiket ile aynı ölçü'.
fix: Use a real label as the specimen, for example 'Belgeli düzeltme'.

where: Builder evidence: shots/1440-hover-0.png to 1440-hover-2.png
problem: These images show the default states (the sampled pixel on the primary button is #143065), because captureBeyondViewport drops :hover; report.json reports changed: true from computed style only. The real hover states are correct (review2/c/h2-a.png).
fix: In shot.js, capture hover probes with captureBeyondViewport: false.

where: #bilesenler > Seçim, help line under the Devamdan muaf switch: "FF, DC, DD ile tekrarda muaf yok; FD ile tekrarda"
problem: The rule is inverted against plan.html#devam (Md.20/5). The plan says the attendance requirement does NOT exist in a course repeated because of FF, DC or DD (the student is exempt) and DOES exist for an FD repeat, a twice-failed clinical course and the Md.28/4 case. The design writes "muaf yok" for FF/DC/DD and "var" for FD, the exact opposite, then claims "Devamdan muaf satırının yardım metni plan.html, Devamsızlık kararıdır." It also cuts the Md.28/4 clause short. A faculty member reading this help line under the switch would mark the wrong students.
fix: Use the plan sentence: "Devam şartı FF, DC ya da DD yüzünden tekrarlanan derste yok; FD ile tekrarda, iki kez kalınan klinik uygulamalı derste ve Md.28/4 kapsamındaki son dönem derslerinde var." Keep the plan link after it. Add this sentence to any copy test that compares UI strings with plan.html.

where: Hero stat tile "Mürekkep #143065", caption "accent.11, yalnız sekiz rolde"
problem: A wrong fact on the first screen. Roles 2 (odak halkası) and 3 (satır içi bağlantı) are accent.9, not accent.11. The #renk accent.11 row itself lists only six uses.
fix: "accent.11; gece mavisi yalnız sekiz rolde (Gece mavisi nerede)", or delete the tile row as proposed in the length finding.

where: #renk tokens status.warning #7839A5 and att.gorevli #652F94; #erisilebilirlik "Renklerin anlamı sabittir."; never-list item "Uyarı ve hata: mor ve kırmızı mürekkep."
problem: Violet carries two meanings: warning (İncelemede, Seviye 2) and Görevli, which is an accepted final status. The two inks are the same family (hue 308 vs 305, OKLab distance about 0.05), and in the panel mock they appear in the same rows (Berk Korkmaz İncelemede, Burak Işık Görevli). That breaks the document's own "meaning is fixed" rule, and the colour-blindness table never compares this pair.
fix: Either set Görevli's ink to neutral.12 and let its work icon carry it (Belgeli düzeltme and Devamdan muaf already share an ink and differ by icon), or define violet explicitly in #renk as "dikkat: uyarı, İncelemede ve Görevli" and add İncelemede vs Görevli to the Renk körlüğü denetimi table. The first option is cleaner.

where: Dialog "Hesabın silinsin mi?" (end of page, dlg-del-t): "Giriş bilgilerin ... silinir ... Derslerin arşivlenir; düzeltmelerin denetim kaydında kalır."
problem: plan.html#kararlar-hesap-silme says: "Silme ekranı ve web adresi neyin silinip neyin kaldığını, nedenini ve süresini yazar". The mock gives neither the reason nor the duration, and the button note sends readers to plan.html, Hesap silme as if this followed it.
fix: Add one line per kept item with its reason and duration, or a visible slot "Neden ve ne kadar süre kalır: ..." filled from the plan's answer, which is still open in plan.html Açık noktalar.

where: #kontrast rows text.disabled (2,99:1 on bg.disabled, 3,71:1 on bg.surface, typed "süs"); #acik 09
problem: The tokens already ship the reading the owner has not approved. plan.html says "yazıda en az 4,5:1" with no exception, and context lists it as an existing decision not to contradict. Calling disabled text "süs" (decoration) is also the wrong word.
fix: Until 09 is answered, default text.disabled to neutral.11 (5,01:1 on bg.disabled) and present the WCAG reading as the alternative. Rename the type "devre dışı (WCAG 1.4.3 dışı)".

where: #tipografi "IBM Plex Sans 3.201 (Fontsource 5.3.0); telefonda statik TTF" vs #kutuphaneler > Telefonun yazı tipi dosyaları "bu dosyalar IBM yapısı (Sans 3.005, Mono 2.005)"
problem: Tipografi says the phone also uses build 3.201. Kütüphaneler says the phone files are build 3.005.
fix: Tipografi: "Panel: Plex Sans 3.201 (Fontsource 5.3.0, değişken WOFF2). Telefon: Plex Sans 3.005 (IBM 1.1.0, statik TTF)."

where: Machine-made or wrong Turkish, with exact quotes
problem: The following sentences read translated or broken: #ozet "Tek dolgu kuralı bölümünde." and "öteki mürekkepler bölümünde." (fragments); #ilkeler 03 "(yayla çizilende yayı)"; #renk "Yok ve Ret göze istisna olarak çarpsın diye"; #tipografi "Satır oranı kayabilen metinde"; #bilesenler Baskı "görünüşü bu maddelerdir"; #erisilebilirlik "Ayar açıkken değişebilir:" (reads as 'while the setting is on'), "(Google bazı uygulamaların kullanmadığını yazar)" and "tek Metin ve tek Dokunulabilir bileşeninde"; #platform "örtü sekme çubuğuyla dikiş verirse"; #acik 02 "en görünür dikiş burada çıkar"; #kutuphaneler "VoiceOver bildirimi duymuyor".
fix: In the same order: "Tek dolgu kuralı: Gece mavisi nerede, 01."; "Görevli mor, öbür durumlar nötr (Durumlar)."; "(yayla çizilen kalıpta yayın değerleri)"; "Yok ve Ret yoğun tabloda gözden kaçmasın diye"; "Birden çok satıra inebilen metinde satır yüksekliği en az 1,25 kat"; "görünüşü şöyle:"; "Ayar uygulama açıkken de değişebilir:"; cut the Google parenthesis; "uygulamanın Text ve Pressable sarmalayıcılarında (Metin, Dokunulabilir)"; "örtü ile sekme çubuğu arasında renk farkı görünürse"; "en görünür uyumsuzluk burada çıkar"; "VoiceOver bildirimi okumuyor".

where: Filler or false sentences: #hareket > Süreler "Aradaki 10 ms'lik farklar bilerek konuldu; her adım tek bir işe bağlıdır."; #erisilebilirlik > Denetim "Geçme ölçütü yukarıdaki kuralın kendisidir."; #panel caption "Bütün sayılar aynı 53 satırdan sayılır: Var 43 + ..."; phone captions "gece mavisi %5,3 · 390 px'te %5,3"
problem: The first sentence is defensive and false: the same table gives dur.mikro four jobs and dur.hizli six. The second says nothing. The third is demo arithmetic that the table caption already states. The fourth prints the same number twice under every phone screen.
fix: Cut all four. On the phone captions, drop "· 390 px'te %X" wherever it equals the first value.

where: Whole document, measured: 27,844 words in my dump vs plan.html 12,551. #tokenlar JSON 4,274 words; #kutuphaneler 18 npm metric strings (228 words); "Telefonun yazı tipi dosyaları" 236 words
problem: The JSON block repeats every value the sections already show and will drift from the real token file. The download counts, star counts and release dates are research evidence, not decisions, and go stale in a repository file. The pyftsubset recipe, app.json setup and byte counts are build detail, which belongs in teknik.html.
fix: Ship tasarim.tokens.json as its own repository file and link to it; keep only Okuma anahtarı (about -4,270 words). Move the npm metrics to the research file and keep "seçim, sürüm, neden, yedek". Move the font subsetting recipe to teknik.html with one sentence and a link left behind.

where: #renk > Durum renkleri tables and Anlam rolleri cards
problem: Several columns never change. "Dolu zemindeki yazı (onSolid)" is #FEFEFF in 4 of 4 rows, "Zemin (subtle)" is #FEFEFF in 3 of 4, and the Son durum table's "Zemin (bg)" is #FEFEFF in 6 of 6. The sentence above already says so. The 37 role cards print the full hex plus OKLCH of a scale step, which the scale tables and the token file already hold: 61 OKLCH strings in #renk.
fix: Drop the three constant columns and keep one sentence ("zemin ve dolu zemindeki yazı neutral.1; yalnız tehlikenin zemini #FCECEB"). Show the role cards as "rol -> adım" only.

where: Typography and spelling consistency
problem: Single quotes are used for plan terms ('seçtim', 'Sunucuya ulaştı', 'yoklamada sınıfta değil', 'QR okutamadı') where elsewhere the same terms use double quotes. The minus sign differs: "b* −2,15" (U+2212, hero) vs "-2,15" (#acik 14). Other pairs: "48x48 dp" (#ozet) vs "48 x 48 dp"; "Kalın metin" (#acik 15) vs "Kalın Metin"; "hareketi azalt ayarına" vs "hareketi azaltma ayarına"; "Reanimated'ın" once vs "Reanimated'in" six times; hero "23 kalem" vs #bicim "23 bileşen".
fix: Use double quotes, one minus sign, "48 x 48 dp", "Kalın Metin", "hareketi azaltma ayarı", "Reanimated'in" and "23 bileşen" throughout.

where: Undefined or overloaded terms: "token" (55 uses, never glossed in Turkish), "mürekkep" (17 uses), "kipli" (#bicim Yükselti), "anahtar" in four senses (Anahtar component, "anahtar rakam", "Röntgen anahtarı", "Okuma anahtarı") on top of plan's cryptographic "anahtar"; pointer named "hassas işaretçi", "imleçli cihaz" and "imleç" while plan's glossary reserves "İmleç" as an internal sync term
problem: A cold reader meets coined terms with no definition, and one word means several things.
fix: First use: "token (tasarım değişkeni)" and "mürekkep: durumun ön plan rengi (yazı, ikon, çerçeve)". Write "kipli" as "modal (örtülü)". Rename "Okuma anahtarı" to "Nasıl okunur" and "Röntgen anahtarı" to "Röntgen düğmesi". Use one pointer term: "fare ve dokunmatik yüzey (işaretçi)".

where: #hareket > Kurallar "Ok tuşuyla gezinme ve klavye kısayolları animasyonsuzdur." vs #etkilesim "focus": ring appears in dur.mikro 100 ms on keyboard focus
problem: With arrow keys moving focus in tabs and menus, a reader cannot tell whether the ring fades in over 100 ms or appears at once. The owner asked for smooth motion on everything the user touches, so any exception needs to be explicit.
fix: "Ok tuşu ve kısayollarla yer değiştiren içerik kaymaz; odak halkası yine 100 ms'de belirir."

where: #bicim lead "2 px yalnız çizgi ve odak boşluğunda" vs Anatomi Damga "dikey 2"; #bicim Boşluk spacing table rows like "kartIci | 16 | sayfaKenariDar | 16"
problem: The badge's 2 px vertical padding breaks the stated rule. The spacing table pairs unrelated phone and panel tokens on the same row, so it reads as if they were equivalents.
fix: Add "ve damganın dikey iç boşluğunda" to the rule. Split the spacing table into two single-platform lists.

where: Research file: 57 ratios with a decimal point ("1.12:1", "14.75:1") vs 331 with a comma; "b* -6,8 ile -12.68 arasına" mixes both in one phrase
problem: The decimal separator is inconsistent in Turkish text.
fix: Use a decimal comma in prose and tables. Keep points only inside code and CSS.

where: #bilesenler > Seçim > Anahtar, help line #sw1-h: 'FF, DC, DD ile tekrarda muaf yok; FD ile tekrarda ... var.'
problem: This reverses plan.html#devam (Md.20/5). The plan says: 'Devam şartı FF, DC ya da DD yüzünden tekrarlanan derste yok (hoca işaretler); FD ... ile tekrarda, iki kez kalınan klinik uygulamalı derste ve Md.28/4 kapsamındaki ... derslerinde var.' So a student repeating after FF, DC or DD is exempt, and after FD is not. The design says the opposite. The line under it, 'Devamdan muaf satırının yardım metni plan.html, Devamsızlık kararıdır', presents the wrong text as the plan's. An instructor reading this help line would mark the wrong students as muaf. findings-r1-flat.json shows the inverted wording came from a misread in fix round 1.
fix: Replace #sw1-h with the plan's meaning: 'FF, DC ya da DD ile tekrarlanan derste devam şartı yok (muaf); FD ile tekrarda, iki kez kalınan klinik uygulamalı derste ve Md.28/4 kapsamındaki derslerde var.' Better: render the plan sentence word for word and link plan.html#devam. Add a gate check that the help line contains 'devam şartı' with the FF/DC/DD clause before 'yok'.

where: #katmanlar Menü 'Öğeler planın hesap işleridir (plan.html, Roller, Hesap silme)'; #platform-ios 'UIDesignRequiresCompatibility eklenmez: iOS 27 SDK ile yok sayılır'; #durumlar card 'Sen değilsen Oturumlarım ekranından kapat · plan.html, E-posta gönderimi'
problem: Three links point to the wrong place. (1) plan.html#kararlar-roller covers the admin and instructor roles and the first-admin command. Oturumlarım and the exit button are under 'Hoca oturumu' (plan.html#kararlar), and the exit rule is in plan.html#kararlar-ogrenci-telefonu. (2) teknik.html#telefon never mentions UIDesignRequiresCompatibility or Liquid Glass (0 matches), so the link cites teknik for a claim teknik does not make. (3) The sentence and the e-mail contents (cihaz türü, saat, kapanan oturum) come from 'Hoca oturumu' (plan.html#kararlar), as #acik-hitap itself states. #kararlar-e-posta-gonderimi holds only the fixed warning sentence.
fix: (1) Link 'plan.html, Kararlar, Hoca oturumu' (plan.html#kararlar) plus plan.html#kararlar-hesap-silme. (2) Cite the Apple source (research id), and move the line to teknik.html#telefon through open point 03, or delete it. (3) Link plan.html#kararlar ('Hoca oturumu') for the card. Keep E-posta gönderimi only for the last line.

where: #katmanlar toast 'Bağlantı geri geldi. Bekleyen 2 kayıt gönderildi.'; #scr-success 'Sunucuya gönderilecek, henüz gönderilmedi'
problem: The plan's receipt states are 'Telefonda kayıtlı, gönderilmedi' and 'Sunucuya ulaştı'. The toast says 'gönderildi', and the offline step 2 repeats 'gönderilmedi' right under step 1.
fix: Toast: 'Bekleyen 2 kayıt sunucuya ulaştı.' Offline step 2: title 'Sunucuya ulaştı' greyed out with 'bekliyor'.

where: #tipografi 'IBM Plex Sans 3.201 (Fontsource 5.3.0); telefonda statik TTF'
problem: #kutuphaneler-yazi says the phone files are the IBM build 3.005 (release 1.1.0), not 3.201.
fix: Write 'panelde 3.201 (Fontsource 5.3.0), telefonda IBM 1.1.0 yapısı (3.005)'.

where: #tipografi Kurallar: 'AKSİS sonuçları ... toLocaleUpperCase('tr-TR') ile hazırlanır'
problem: These are constant strings. Producing them in packages/core would break teknik.html#kod (core uses no Intl and no locale).
fix: Say 'sabit metin olarak yazılır (DEVAMLI, DEVAMSIZ, KARAR BEKLİYOR)'.
